main_text.p: Deo, quo naturam hanc morticinam superbè decoremus? Modestè Tiberius è multis quę restituisset perfecisset que ædificijs, nullum sibi vendicauit, sed nomina illorum indidit, à quibus ædificari coepta. At isti sibi arrogant ædes, quibus ne tegulam quidem vnam imposuerint. Abfit hoc à nobis turpe sacrilegium, cum vendicet id sibi Deus verè, sancteq; Zelotypus Operari in nobis & velle, & facere; Ipsum velle credere (vt rectè Augustinus) Ecce non excitat sed ἐνεργεῖ: Operatur ergo & quod primum est, velle, & quod vltimum (ἐνεργεῖν) perficere: velle & cur-Xiphilin.Tiber.De Grat.& Lib.ar.c.16.

page.notes: Right margin notes are "Xiphilin.Tiber." and "De Grat.& Lib.ar.c.16." Some faint show-through from the reverse page is present and omitted. The word "vnam" and "vendicet" are as printed; "perfecisset" is read as printed with some uncertainty. Greek words in the text are approximated: "ἐνεργεῖ" (first occurrence, printed ἐνεργεῖ with a diacritic) and "ἐνεργεῖν" are read from the scan with [?] advisable.
